resources.string: One UI files in the other system
The other system keeps its own storage and sees none of One UI\'s files.

Recommended. Shows One UI\'s albums in the other system, each as its own album, read-only: it cannot edit or delete them. Nothing in One UI\'s Android folder is shared. Applies at the next switch or guest restart.
One UI\'s DCIM, Pictures, Download, Documents, Movies and Music appear in the other system, and apps there can change and delete them. Applies at the next switch or guest restart.
Apps in the other system can change and delete your real photos, downloads, documents, videos and music. Use only if you need it.
Off: %1$s. Remove it from a root shell, then turn this on.
One UI has no album with photos or videos to share. Folders in Android are never shared.
ColorOS shows no album: the list of hidden albums %1$s. Saving a choice replaces a wrong file; a link or a folder there must be removed from a root shell first.
%1$d albums with very long folder paths cannot be listed here; ColorOS shows them.
